Package marker for backend.
Package marker for backend.agents.
Package marker for backend.agents.evaluation, answer grading with no LLM.

Feedback for a graded answer, pure: render(grade, evidence) builds one or two sentences from fixed templates, the question's key terms and a verbatim evidence snippet; low confidence gives no verdict, closed questions name the expected answer, free text says what was captured and missed and never 'correct'.

Answer grader: pure decide(GradeInput) gives a 0..1 score, a high, medium or low confidence, matched and missing key terms, the rule used and its components; cloze and multiple choice by exact or rapidfuzz match, free text by a weighted sum of evidence cosine, key-term coverage and a relevance check; grade_all embeds a test's free-text answers in one call with the embedder it is given.

Evaluator node, no LLM: turns stored session questions into grader inputs, grades a test with the local grader in one embedding call on a worker thread (reusing a pre-graded answer whose text is unchanged), writes feedback from templates, inserts test_results with score 0-10, feedback and confidence per answer, updates the rolling average in reading_progress and appends to decisions; a question with no evidence is graded against the passage at low confidence.
Builds the LangGraph workflow: routes from __start__ by state status to planner, test_generator, evaluator or optimizer, each ending at END.
Optimizer node: score thresholds set the chunk multiplier and re-read queue; the Groq LLM picks the next focus duration; saves pace_recommendation.
Planner node: serves the re-read queue first, otherwise asks the Groq LLM how many of the next three chunks to assign; falls back to one chunk for 20 minutes.
Policy constants for the agents: every threshold, weight and limit in one place; so far question generation, test assembly, grading and feedback.
Package marker for backend.agents.question_generation, questions built from a chunk's own sentences with no LLM.

QuestionGenerationAgent.run(book_id, chunk_ids): builds, filters and scores questions for chunks with the local embedder only and upserts them into question_bank (on conflict do nothing); returns a GenerationReport.

Pure test assembly: picks a session's questions from bank rows by a mix of strategies, preferring unused, difficulty-matched questions; builds the stored form (with answers) and the public form (question, type, options only).
Pure quality filter for generated questions: rejects stopword answers, short evidence and prompts that contain the answer, scores the rest 0..1, and drops the weaker of two near-duplicate prompts.
Pure extractive question strategies over one chunk's sentences and concepts; every question carries evidence that appears verbatim in the chunk.
AgentState TypedDict shared by all agent nodes, including the decisions audit trail.

Old test generator node: asks the Groq LLM for five questions with RAG context and falls back to generic ones. Still wired into the LangGraph workflow, but no longer called by the session router since C5.5.
get_current_user FastAPI dependency: resolves a Supabase JWT to a user id through supabase.auth.get_user; anything else is a 401.
FastAPI app: CORS, the five routers and /health. Starts no other process.
Standalone FastMCP server with three Supabase tools (reading history, comprehension trend, chunk context); not started by the app since C3.4 and not called by any agent; kept for manual use.
Package marker for backend.nlp, the local NLP building blocks (no API calls).

Concepts of a chunk: YAKE key phrases, normalised (lower case, stopwords stripped, plurals reduced), near-duplicates merged by rapidfuzz, embedding cosine or shared words, each with a stable concept key slug and a 0..1 weight.
Local embeddings: one lazily loaded, thread-safe fastembed model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384 dimensions, cache in FASTEMBED_CACHE); embed and embed_one return unit-length float32 vectors.

Pure text utilities, standard library only: normalize (PDF hyphenation, line breaks, quotes), split_sentences with an abbreviation guard, tokenize, STOPWORDS, content_words, and informativeness, a 0..1 sentence score.
Package marker for backend.routers.
Empty APIRouter mounted at /agent; defines no endpoints.
GET /auth/profile and POST /auth/profile/calibrate: read the profile and save the calibrated reading speed.
Book endpoints: upload to Storage and start ingestion in the background, list, details with progress, status poll, delete.
GET /dashboard: aggregates book progress, scores over time, reading streak, words this week and recent feedback.

Session lifecycle endpoints: start (planner, then the test is assembled from the question bank and the grading model warmed in the background), finish-reading (returns the public part of the test), evaluate-single (grades one answer inline and caches it; tells the client nothing), submit-answers (grades inline with the local evaluator, then the optimizer; returns score, feedback and confidence per question), abandon, get; no answer or evidence is sent to the client before the test is submitted.
Package marker for backend.services.

Extracts text from PDF and EPUB, chunks it by paragraph to about 600 words, embeds the chunks in batches with the local model into chunks.embedding_local, marks the book ready after the first five chunks, then has the question generation agent fill the question bank for each batch.
Google AI Studio embedding client (gemini-embedding-2, 1536 dimensions) with retry; raises at import if the key is missing. Banned provider.
Groq ChatGroq client (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) exported under five agent names; raises at import if the key is missing. Banned provider.
assemble_session_test: reads the bank rows of a session's chunks, generates them on demand for chunks that have none, stores the picked questions with the session and increments times_used.

Hybrid retrieval over one book's chunks: local-embedding vector search (match_chunks_local) and Postgres full-text search (search_chunks_text) merged with reciprocal rank fusion; get_similar_chunks keeps its signature.
Creates the shared service-role Supabase client; raises at import if the URL or key is missing.

Labelled answers for calibrating the grader: 34 cases over five questions, each with question, type, evidence, key terms, an answer, a category (correct, paraphrase, partial, wrong, off-topic, empty, copy of the question) and a hand-given human_score from 0 to 1.
Pytest: the labelled answer fixtures have every field, unique ids, every category and type, scores inside their category's band, key terms taken from the evidence, and truly empty and copied answers.

Pytest on an in-memory database through TestClient, with a bag-of-words fake embedder: tests come from the question bank in one round trip and leak nothing; answers are graded inline with confidence and feedback, pre-grades are cached and reused, a failing embedder or a question with no evidence gives low confidence, and test_results keeps the shape the results page and dashboard read.
Pytest: get_current_user rejects a raw UUID token with 401 and returns the user id for a token Supabase accepts (supabase.auth mocked).

Pytest: each feedback template and its conditions, term lists, the evidence snippet, and over the labelled fixtures that feedback holds only template words, key terms and verbatim evidence.

Pytest: closed-question matching, the free-text formula and its components, every confidence rule and its boundary, grade_all's single embedding call and its failure path, on hand-made numbers; plus agreement with the labelled answer fixtures on the real model when it is cached.

Pytest: the suite uses the dummy environment and the fakes, outbound connections are blocked, loopback works, and a protected endpoint answers 401.
Pytest on hand-made bank rows: the default mix, unused and difficulty preferences, no repeated sentence or answer, spread over chunks, option order, and the public form of a question.
